Agendamea CLI v{version} (ag | agenda | agendamea)

Komandat e Terminalit dhe CLI (ag):
  ag                                 undefined

  ag show 1                          undefined
  ag ok 1                            undefined
  ag rm 2                            undefined
  ag find <q>                        undefined
  ag undo                            undefined
  ag stat                            undefined

Serveri MCP (Integrimi i asistentit AI) / undefined:
  ag mcp [list|install|doctor]       Integrimet e klientëve MCP
  ag serve [start|stop|status]       undefined
  ag hook [set|logs|outbox|test]     Radha dalëse e webhook (Outbox)
  ag ai [status|models|download]     Statusi i pajisjeve dhe modeleve lokale AI

labels.fullHelp:
Agendamea CLI v{version} - undefined

DETYRAT:
  ag [today|imp|done|/Category]      undefined
  ag + <title> [@today] [p:high]     undefined
  ag show <1|id|keyword>             undefined
  ag edit <1|id|keyword> [fields]    undefined
  ag ok <1|id|keyword>               undefined
  ag rm <1|id|keyword>               undefined
  ag find <keyword>                  undefined
  ag matrix                          undefined

NËNDETYRA / KATEGORITË / KOSHI:
  ag sub <task> [+ | ok | edit | rm] undefined
  ag cat [+ | edit | move | rm]      undefined
  ag trash [-q | delete | empty]     undefined
  ag undo [1|keyword]                undefined

CILËSIMET / SERVERI MCP (INTEGRIMI I ASISTENTIT AI):
  ag export / ag import / ag sync    undefined
  ag config [key value|--list]       undefined
  ag serve [start|stop|status]       undefined
  ag hook [set|logs|outbox|test]     Radha dalëse e webhook (Outbox)
  ag mcp [list|install|doctor]       Integrimet e klientëve MCP
  ag doctor                          Kontrolli i shëndetit të sistemit Agendamea (Doctor)
